def count_ways(n, k):
    if k == 0:
        return 0
    
    dp = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    dp[0][0] = 1
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        for j in range(i + 1):
            dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j]
            if j > 0:
                dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j - 1]
                dp[i][j] %= MOD
            if j < k:
                dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j + 1]
                dp[i][j] %= MOD
    
    result = 0
    for j in range(k + 1):
        result += dp[n][j]
        result %= MOD
    
    return result
